# Text

The one way to set copy: a Text takes a type-scale step (textStyle) and a tone, so no component writes its own font rules.

`NomNom.Text` · Foundations

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Text>…</NomNom.Text>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Text">…</x-import>
```

## Props (TextProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `textStyle` | `'serif-xs' \| 'serif-sm' \| 'serif-md' \| 'serif-lg' \| 'serif-xl' \| 'sans-xs' \| 'sans-sm' \| 'sans-md' …` | A Typography token. @default 'sans-md' |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'accent'` | primary = text-primary · accent = primary-text (scores, live counts). @default 'primary' |
| `weight` | `'normal' \| 'semibold'` |  |
| `italic` | `boolean` |  |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | Tabular figures. |
| `align` | `'center'` |  |
| `lines` | `number` | Clamp to N lines. |
| `as` | `string` | @default 'span' |
| `children` | `unknown` |  |
